# opnsense_firmware_plugin (Resource)

Installs an OPNsense plugin package (**System ▸ Firmware ▸ Plugins**), e.g. `os-squid` before managing `opnsense_proxy_settings`. The firewall must reach its package mirror, and OPNsense refuses to install plugins while the firmware itself is out of date. Destroying the resource removes the plugin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_firmware_plugin" "squid" {
  name = "os-squid"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Package name, e.g. `os-squid`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
- `version` (String) Installed version.
